veranderings.rede: Afrikaans puts goods 'op die mark', not 'in die mark'.

veranderings.voor: rus en water en kos kry
veranderings.rede: The doubled 'en' reads clumsily; a plain three-item list is smoother and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: sonder om hom heeltemal weg te gooi
veranderings.na: sonder om dit heeltemal weg te gooi
veranderings.rede: In written standard Afrikaans 'dit' is the usual pronoun for a thing such as a source; 'hom' is colloquial.

vlae.blok: Wat die boek van Asië vertel
vlae.teks: Plekke waar speserye gekweek is en waar sy gemaak is.
vlae.rede: 'sy' (silk) can be read as the pronoun 'she'; a clearer noun such as 'systof' would remove the ambiguity, but it narrows silk to fabric, so the writer should choose.
